ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage against a ~85-90% low-intensity (black) base surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of high-intensity white circular and linear clusters on a black ground; high-intensity density peaks at the lateral distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; vertex angle approximately 40 degrees, partially obscured at base by water-surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys measured along the entire trailing boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve fitted from the medial notch to the lateral tips, characterized by an increasing slope towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected high-density of circular white rings (annular formations) across the mid-region and distal third of both lobes; diameters range from approximately 5 to 15 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected multi-directional white linear tracks; prominent vertical and diagonal rake marks visible on the left lobe and lower-central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular barnacle scars and linear rake marks across the visible ventral surface; heavy white encrustation present at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-intensity white tip encrustations localized at the outermost terminal edges of the fluke lobes.
